review_mode: Independent exact-source composition review; no builds or edits
findings: FactoryCallEntry.args uses actual c.entryWorld, c.originalWorld, c.substate and c.environment. Its execution_eq is definitional, so the child Xi is the actual message-call execution rather than an independently selected interpreter run.

The pre-transfer factory lookup/code and nonce, distinct sender/target, actual funded value, total-world bound and apparent/transferred-value coherence derive the actual post-transfer creator nonce/value gates. The finite pair-balance bound proves recipient credit fits; no post-transfer sufficient balance or recipient no-wrap assertion is supplied.

FactoryInitializedExecution is instantiated once with those arguments and all explicit resource/collision/address inputs. It produces the actual successful Xi result and Invariant0/log/selfDestruct fields on identical world/substate witnesses.

c.fuel=steps+18 rewrites the actual Xi fuel through FactoryCallEntry.execution_eq. FactoryReturnEncoding.output_address normalizes the very same returned output to canonical AccountAddress.toByteArray.

The literal Theta world-nonempty BEq guard is derived from the produced invariant CodeAt witness via WorldNonempty.beq_empty_false_of_get_some; it is not assumed or inferred from an arbitrary structural world inequality.

MessageCall.success_commits_world then commits exactly that Xi tuple, output and world. The final invariant and log/selfDestruct equalities refer to the same committed Theta result, with args.substate definitionally c.substate.

The new quantified frame composes CodeStorageFrame.entry c protectedAddr with the exact Xi hframes from FactoryCallEntry.args c. Endpoints are c.world -> actual c.entryWorld -> the same successful result w. The Theta nonempty guard and tuple settlement are unchanged.

Frame exclusions are explicit factoryAddress!=protectedAddr and created canonical address!=protectedAddr. The new frame preserves code/existence/persistent storage, not balances or complete account identity.
assumptions_and_limits: Retains installed factory lookup/code, target identity, nonce allowance, distinct caller/target, funded value and pre-world total<UInt256.size, value coherence, permission/depth, exact calldata, gas1M..2^64, steps>=13 and exact c.fuel, actual child collision freedom, and canonical preimage-address equation. None is claimed to be produced from canonical deployment history here.
The distinct caller/target restriction is explicit; self-calls are not covered by this deployment entry theorem. This is not a restriction imposed on all protocol transactions.

Both c.code and old.code are supplied as the same runtime. Actual transaction code selection must still bind its MessageCall.Context to this installed code; the theorem does not perform canonical transaction extraction.
Parent transaction Upsilon finalization/cleanup and external ancestor survival remain separate obligations; complete actual Theta success is established, not a protocol deployment certificate.
No reference Amsterdam semantics/gas correspondence or fork-policy adoption is asserted.
